intent: Define the canonical terminology for UBVM, SCP, and the Forge Theory ecosystem, ensuring consistent interpretation across runtimes, documents, and organisms.

interpretation.this_is: The official glossary of UBVM — the authoritative vocabulary for capsules, primitives, triggers, interpreter behaviour, and ecosystem concepts.
purpose: Provide canonical definitions for all UBVM and SCP terms
Prevent semantic drift across implementations and documents
Serve as the reference vocabulary for capsule authors and primitive developers
Anchor the conceptual language of the Forge Theory ecosystem
importance: Definitions of capsule, primitive, behaviour, trigger, interpreter
ignore: Examples that are illustrative rather than normative
Domain-specific artefacts not part of UBVM Core

guarantees: All terms defined in this glossary are canonical for UBVM and SCP.
Definitions override informal usage in code comments or external documents.
Terms remain stable across UBVM versions unless explicitly deprecated.
This glossary forms the semantic backbone for all UBVM organisms.
non_guarantees: Experimental or provisional terms not yet added to the glossary.
Interpretations of terms in third-party runtimes.
semantic_contract.conflict_resolution: If contradictions arise, prefer glossary definitions over README, code comments, or external documentation.

provenance.author: James / Giblets Creations
provenance.context: Created during UBVM documentation session, May 2026. Revised to move semantic_contract into interpretation, add provenance, correct capture_mode, remove duplicate core_identity link, add daily validation behaviour, and add scp/spec link.
